64 Q heads
4 groups ×16 Q
128 per head" style="html=0;whiteSpace=wrap;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;fontFamily=Arial;fontSize=22;fontColor=#1D1D1A;fontStyle=0;fillColor=#EDF4FA;strokeColor=#688BA8;strokeWidth=1.8;spacing=8;shape=rectangle;rounded=1;arcSize=7;" vertex="1" parent="1" role="compute"> <mxGeometry x="1040" y="405" width="225" height="120" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="content_kv" value="Main K / V
4 group KV heads
128 per head" style="html=0;whiteSpace=wrap;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;fontFamily=Arial;fontSize=22;fontColor=#1D1D1A;fontStyle=0;fillColor=#EDF4FA;strokeColor=#688BA8;strokeWidth=1.8;spacing=8;shape=rectangle;rounded=1;arcSize=7;" vertex="1" parent="1" role="compute"> <mxGeometry x="755" y="405" width="250" height="105" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="selected_kv" value="Gather group-specific K / V
K_g[S_g(i)], V_g[S_g(i)]" style="html=0;whiteSpace=wrap;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;fontFamily=Arial;fontSize=22;fontColor=#1D1D1A;fontStyle=0;fillColor=#EDF4FA;strokeColor=#688BA8;strokeWidth=1.8;spacing=8;shape=rectangle;rounded=1;arcSize=7;" vertex="1" parent="1" role="compute"> <mxGeometry x="755" y="1120" width="350" height="104" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="exact_attention" value="Exact content attention
A_g = Softmax(Q_g K_g[S_g]^T /√128 + M)
Output_g = A_g V_g[S_g]
M: causal j ≤ i in all selected blocks,
including the local block" style="html=0;whiteSpace=wrap;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;fontFamily=Arial;fontSize=20;fontColor=#1D1D1A;fontStyle=0;fillColor=#EDF4FA;strokeColor=#688BA8;strokeWidth=1.8;spacing=8;shape=rectangle;rounded=1;arcSize=7;" vertex="1" parent="1" role="compute"> <mxGeometry x="750" y="1310" width="520" height="150" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="attn_output_proj" value="Concatenate all query heads & output projection" style="html=0;whiteSpace=wrap;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;fontFamily=Arial;fontSize=23;fontColor=#1D1D1A;fontStyle=0;fillColor=#EDF4FA;strokeColor=#688BA8;strokeWidth=1.8;spacing=8;shape=rectangle;rounded=1;arcSize=7;" vertex="1" parent="1" role="compute"> <mxGeometry x="335" y="1550" width="690" height="70" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="attention_output" value="Attention output" style="html=0;whiteSpace=wrap;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;fontFamily=Arial;fontSize=23;fontColor=#1D1D1A;fontStyle=0;fillColor=#D7E3EC;strokeColor=#628D9B;strokeWidth=1.8;spacing=8;shape=rectangle;rounded=1;arcSize=7;" vertex="1" parent="1" role="communication"> <mxGeometry x="480" y="1700" width="400" height="62" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="msa_scope" value="Index K is shared across groups; main K / V are group-specific. No attention output gate.
Q/K normalization, positional encoding and cache implementation details are omitted here.
The same MSA mechanism is used in all 60 decoder layers." style="html=0;whiteSpace=wrap;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontFamily=Arial;fontSize=18;fontColor=#596671;fontStyle=0;fillColor=none;strokeColor=none;strokeWidth=1.8;spacing=8;shape=rectangle;spacing=0;" vertex="1" parent="1" role="text-secondary"> <mxGeometry x="60" y="1790" width="1240" height="72" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
